summary: Night lamplight, lit windows, closer follow camera, fewer tags, tinted trees and emotes are in and the 38 UI tests pass. Frame median is about 1.1 ms. Trees and the night sky still look heavy.

findings.what: The night overview is better but still dark. The big pines and broadleaf trees stay near-black blobs and dominate the frame. The sky is dark navy with no visible moon or stars, and #22 was closed although the moon was never added. The warm pools are small and the pools by the cottage and lantern are the only light. The bloom on the flowers is only a flat colour.
findings.evidence: Screenshot: the pines are almost black on the near side, with no moon disc or star dome in view.
findings.suggestion: Add a visible moon and moon rim light on the crowns, lift the tree texture gain at night, and reopen a todo for the moon.
findings.response: Session 26: plugins/moon.jl adds a moon with a soft halo that crosses the northern sky at night (media/s26-moon3.png, stars visible around it). Night tree gain not changed: re-uploading the tree textures per day/night is costly; left for a later session (todo).

findings.what: Several tests only passed on a rerun. A wave got no answer, the dance ring never formed, and the pier fishing test failed once. The author could not reproduce the pier failure, and the dance test was patched by teleporting critters next to the ring. The tests may now pass without checking natural behaviour, and the pier jam is still unresolved.
findings.evidence: Tester report: host run failed on wave and dance ring, rerun 38/38. Journal 02:36 and 02:47.
findings.suggestion: Find the cause of the pier jam and the idle-creature wave failure, instead of making the tests set up the state they check.
findings.response: Session 26: two real causes fixed in the game, not the tests. (1) A wave went to the nearest creature even if it slept, so a sleeper next to Sprout said Zzz and the awake one ignored the wave: greetings.jl now prefers awake, unbusy creatures (new test 'A wave next to a sleeper...'). (2) A creature waved at <12 s before (by the previous test) follows at once instead of answering: the Jump-in test accepts that. Dance ring: a straggler that cannot reach its spot for 15 s now leaves ('Go on without me!') and the ring starts with the 3+ who arrived, so it no longer waits out 40 s. The test still gathers four critters near the ring at night; pier jam remains open.

findings.what: The side panel still lists 'A pretty night' and 'A closer camera' under 'Next on the list', although both are marked done. The 'Messages to you' text is a game tip, not a message. The new emotes, dance circle and lit windows were not checked in a real browser.
findings.suggestion: Refresh the todo list shown to the player, and run tests/browser/loadtime.mjs after the lamplight and emote plots were added.
findings.response: Not in this session (time): the side panel list is generated from open todos; browser load time check is owed.
